<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Legacy Care · Parts Planning Hub</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#4F3EAF">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Legacy Care">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="manifest" href="data:application/manifest+json;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --brand:#4F3EAF;--brand-sub:#F0EEFF;--brand-bd:#C4BAF0;
  --bg:#F6F7F9;--surface:#FFFFFF;--surface3:#F1F2F6;
  --bd:#E6E8EF;--bd-lt:#F0F1F6;--bd-md:#D1D5E0;
  --t1:#111827;--t2:#374151;--t3:#6B7280;--t4:#9CA3AF;
  --grn:#1A6B3B;--red:#991B1B;--amb:#92400E;--side:#1B1F27;
  --r:6px;--r-lg:12px;--r-pill:999px;
  --sh-xs:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05);--sh-sm:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
html{font-size:16px}
body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:var(--t1);background:var(--bg);display:flex;min-height:100vh}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
.sidebar{width:196px;min-width:196px;background:var(--side);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:16px 10px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  padding:2px 10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);margin-bottom:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.logo span span{color:#8B7FD6}
.logo-mark{width:15px;height:15px;flex:none}
.logo-mark rect{animation:rg-bar 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom}
.logo-mark rect:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-.5s}
.logo-mark rect:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-1s}
.logo-mark rect:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-1.5s}
@keyframes rg-bar{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}50%{transform:scaleY(.42)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.logo-mark rect{animation:none}}
.side-lbl{font-size:8px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding:0 10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-bottom:2px}
.nav.active{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.nav.dim{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
.nav:not(.dim){cursor:pointer}
.nav:not(.dim):not(.active):hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
.ws{display:none}
.ws.active{display:block}
.side-foot{margin-top:auto;font-size:8.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:10px;line-height:1.5}
.wrap{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.main{padding:18px 24px 32px;flex:1}
.page-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.page-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);margin:2px 0 14px}
.warn{background:#FEF3C7;border:1px solid #FDE68A;color:#92400E;font-size:10.5px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:var(--r);margin-bottom:12px}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);margin-bottom:14px}
.tab{padding:6px 14px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:var(--t3);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;font-family:inherit}
.tab:hover{color:var(--t2)}
.tab.active{color:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);font-weight:600;background:var(--brand-sub)}
.pane{display:none}.pane.active{display:block}
/* Filtro New/CO */
.fbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fbar-l{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t2)}
.fchip{padding:4px 13px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid var(--bd-md);background:var(--surface);font-size:10px;font-weight:500;color:var(--t3);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.fchip.active{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:#fff;font-weight:600}
/* Cards */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:12px}
.lc-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh-xs);transition:box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s;display:none;flex-direction:column}
.lc-card.show{display:flex}
/* Sourcing Overview não usa o filtro New/CO — cards sempre visíveis */
#ws-planejamento .lc-card{display:flex}
.lc-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);border-color:var(--bd-md)}
.lc-car-photo{height:150px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;padding:6px}
.lc-car-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.lc-car-ph{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--t4);font-size:10px}
.lc-card-hd{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-model{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.lc-sub{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:2px}
.ph{padding:1px 7px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:8px;font-weight:700}
.ph-care{background:var(--brand-sub);color:var(--brand)}
.ph-vs{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--t3)}
.ph-na{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--t4)}
.lc-badge{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid currentColor;white-space:nowrap}
.hd-dir{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:2px;flex:none}
.sh-b{width:22px;height:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--brand-bd);background:var(--brand-sub);
  color:var(--brand);cursor:pointer;padding:0;flex:none;transition:all .15s}
.sh-b:hover{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
.sh-b.busy{opacity:.45;cursor:wait}
.fq-b{margin-left:5px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1px solid var(--brand-bd);
  background:var(--brand-sub);color:var(--brand);font-size:6.5px;font-weight:700;
  cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;vertical-align:middle}
.fq-b:hover{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
/* Altura idêntica à do bloco de KPIs — o card não cresce ao abrir */
.lc-freq{position:relative;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt);padding:6px 12px 7px}
.fq-x{position:absolute;top:2px;right:5px;border:none;background:none;color:var(--t4);
  font-size:13px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;padding:0 3px;z-index:2}
.fq-x:hover{color:var(--brand)}
.fq-row{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:stretch}
.fq-leg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:none;font-size:7px;color:var(--t4);
  font-weight:600;padding-right:2px}
.fq-leg div{height:13px;line-height:13px}
.fq-leg div:first-child{height:11px}
.fq-c{flex:1;text-align:center;border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface3);padding:1px 0 2px}
.fq-c.fq-off{opacity:.4}
.fq-l{font-size:7.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--t3);height:11px;line-height:11px}
.fq-v{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;height:13px;line-height:13px;
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:var(--t2)}
.fq-v span{font-size:7px}
.fq-v.fq-na{color:var(--t4)}
/* Carrossel */
.slides{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;flex:1;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none}
.slides::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.slide{flex:0 0 100%;scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:222px}
.dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 0 9px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.dot-b{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--bd-md);background:var(--surface);cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.dot-b.on{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand)}
.slide-t{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--t3);padding:8px 12px 4px}
.slide-s{font-size:8.5px;color:var(--t4);padding:2px 12px 8px}
.slide-empty{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--t4);font-size:10.5px;padding:1.5rem;text-align:center}
/* KPIs */
.lc-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-kpis3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-kpi{padding:7px 12px;border-right:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-kpis .lc-kpi:last-child,.lc-kpis3 .lc-kpi:last-child{border-right:none}
.lc-kpi-l{font-size:8px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--t4);margin-bottom:2px}
.lc-kpi-v{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1}
.lc-kpis3 .lc-kpi-v{font-size:12px}
.lc-kpi-s{font-size:8.5px;color:var(--t4);margin-top:1px}
/* Selo de variação vs execução anterior */
.dlt{display:inline-block;margin-left:5px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  font-size:8px;font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle;letter-spacing:-.01em;cursor:help}
.dlt-b{background:var(--grn-bg,#D1FAE5);color:var(--grn)}
.dlt-r{background:#FEE2E2;color:var(--red)}
.dlt-0{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--t4)}
.lc-cnt .dlt{margin-left:3px;font-size:7px;padding:0 3px}
.ref-dlt{font-size:8px;color:var(--t4);padding:0 12px 6px}
.lc-bar{height:2px;background:var(--bd-lt);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px}
.lc-fill{height:100%;border-radius:2px}
.lc-cnts{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-cnt{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:6px 3px;border-right:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.lc-cnt:last-child{border-right:none}
.lc-cnt-v{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
.lc-cnt-l{font-size:7px;color:var(--t4);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-top:1px}
.lc-ft{padding:8px 12px;margin-top:auto}
.lc-btn{width:100%;padding:6px;border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--brand-bd);background:var(--brand-sub);color:var(--brand);font-size:10px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.lc-btn:hover{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}
/* Gráficos */
.bridge{width:100%;padding:0 8px}
.gl{stroke:var(--bd-lt);stroke-width:.5}
.ga{font-size:5px;fill:var(--t4);text-anchor:end;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace}
.bl{font-size:6.4px;fill:var(--t1);text-anchor:middle;font-weight:700}
.bx{font-size:6px;fill:var(--t3);text-anchor:middle;font-weight:600}
.bg{cursor:pointer}
.bg rect{transition:opacity .12s}
.slide.dim .bg:not(.on) rect{opacity:.3}
/* Legenda do bridge — identifica a peça sem depender de hover */
.blg{padding:3px 12px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.blg-i{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:9px;padding:2px 4px;
  border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer}
.blg-i:hover{background:var(--surface3)}
.blg-i.on{background:var(--brand-sub)}
.blg-r{flex:none;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;color:#fff;font-size:7.5px;
  font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.blg-r.b-gap{background:#D9A441}.blg-r.b-out{background:#9CA3AF}
.blg-pn{flex:none;font-size:8.5px;color:var(--t1);font-weight:600}
.blg-d{flex:1;color:var(--t3);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.blg-pp{flex:none;color:var(--amb);font-weight:700;font-size:8.5px}
.b-base{fill:var(--brand)}
.b-gap{fill:#D9A441}
.b-out{fill:#9CA3AF}
.b-meta{fill:#CBD5D1;stroke:var(--grn);stroke-width:.8}
.pz{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:2px 12px 6px}
.pie{width:88px;height:88px;flex:none}
.ptab{flex:1;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:8.5px}
.ptab th{text-align:right;color:var(--t4);font-weight:600;padding:1px 4px;font-size:7.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
.ptab th:first-child{text-align:left}
.ptab td{padding:1.5px 4px;text-align:right;color:var(--t2)}
.ptab td:first-child{text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:var(--t1)}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:4px}
.ttab{width:calc(100% - 24px);margin:2px 12px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:8.5px}
.ttab th{text-align:left;color:var(--t4);font-weight:600;font-size:7.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 3px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
.ttab td{padding:2.5px 3px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt);color:var(--t2)}
.ttab .mono{font-size:8px}
.tdesc{max-width:82px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tsrc{max-width:56px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tr-r{text-align:right}
.pareto{font-size:8.5px;color:var(--t3);padding:5px 12px}
#shareOv{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(15,17,23,.62);
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px}
#shareOv.on{display:flex}
.sv-box{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-lg);max-width:420px;width:100%;
  max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3);padding:12px}
.sv-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px}
.sv-hd span{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--t2)}
.sv-x{border:none;background:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1;color:var(--t4);cursor:pointer;padding:0 4px}
#shareImg{width:100%;border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--bd);display:block}
.sv-dica{font-size:10px;color:var(--t3);text-align:center;padding:8px 0 10px}
.sv-acoes{display:flex;gap:7px}
.sv-b{flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--bd-md);background:var(--surface);
  color:var(--t2);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;
  text-align:center;text-decoration:none}
.sv-b:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
.sv-b1{background:var(--brand-sub);border-color:var(--brand-bd);color:var(--brand)}
.footbar{background:var(--surface);border-top:1px solid var(--bd);padding:12px 24px;margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fb-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.fb-sub{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3);margin-top:1px}
.fb-meta{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--t3);text-align:right;line-height:1.55}
.fb-meta strong{color:var(--t1)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  body{flex-direction:column}
  .sidebar{width:100%;min-width:0;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;gap:10px}
  .logo{padding:0 12px 0 0;border-bottom:none;margin-bottom:0;font-size:13px}
  .side-lbl,.side-foot,.nav.dim{display:none}
  .nav{margin-bottom:0;padding:5px 12px;white-space:nowrap}
  .footbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;padding:10px 14px}
  .fb-meta{text-align:left}
  .main{padding:12px 12px 28px}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .toolbar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .search{max-width:none}
  .chips{overflow-x:auto;flex-wrap:nowrap;padding-bottom:4px}
  .chip{flex:0 0 auto}
  .tabs{overflow-x:auto}
  .tab{white-space:nowrap}
  table.dt{min-width:980px}
  .tblwrap{-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
}
@media (max-width:480px){
  .lc-cnts{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .lc-cnt{flex:1 1 33%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd-lt)}
  .lc-cnt:nth-last-child(-n+3){border-bottom:none}
}
@media print{.sidebar,.toolbar,.tabs,.lc-btn,.dots{display:none!important}body{background:#fff}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<aside class="sidebar">
  <div class="logo">
    <svg class="logo-mark" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <rect x="2" y="14" width="4" height="8" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".42"/>
      <rect x="8.5" y="10" width="4" height="12" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".55"/>
      <rect x="15" y="12" width="4" height="10" fill="#fff" fill-opacity=".48"/>
      <rect x="20" y="6" width="4" height="16" fill="var(--brand)"/>
    </svg>
    <span>RG<span>dB</span> S&amp;OP Hub</span>
  </div>
  <div class="side-lbl">Workspaces</div>
  <div class="nav dim" title="Disponível no Parts Planning Hub"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><rect width="7" height="7" x="3" y="3" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="14" y="3" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="14" y="14" rx="1"/><rect width="7" height="7" x="3" y="14" rx="1"/></svg> Kanban C2/PD</div>
  <div class="nav active" id="nav-legacy" onclick="irWorkspace('legacy')"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><path d="M19 14c1.49-1.46 3-3.21 3-5.5A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 16.5 3c-1.76 0-3 .5-4.5 2-1.5-1.5-2.74-2-4.5-2A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 2 8.5c0 2.3 1.5 4.05 3 5.5l7 7Z"/></svg> Legacy Care</div>
  <div class="nav" id="nav-planejamento" onclick="irWorkspace('planejamento')"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><polyline points="22 7 13.5 15.5 8.5 10.5 2 17"/><polyline points="16 7 22 7 22 13"/></svg> Planejamento</div>
  <div class="nav dim" title="Disponível no Parts Planning Hub"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3Z"/><path d="M12 9v4"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/></svg> Carteira em Atenção</div>
  <div class="nav dim" title="Disponível no Parts Planning Hub"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="15" height="15"><path d="M22 12h-4l-3 9L9 3l-3 9H2"/></svg> Evolução</div>
  <div class="side-foot">Parts Planning Hub<br>Legacy Care · snapshot estático<br>Gerador v4.2.0</div>
</aside>

<div class="wrap">
  <div class="main">
    

    <div id="ws-legacy" class="ws active">
    <div class="page-title">Legacy Care</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Ciclo de vida dos projetos — O cliente RGdB continuará protegido?</div>

    <div class="tabs"><button class="tab active">Project Overview</button></div>

    <div id="pane-overview" class="pane active">
      <div class="fbar">
        <span class="fbar-l">Peças:</span>
        <button class="fchip active" data-f="total" onclick="setFiltro('total',this)">Total</button>
        <button class="fchip" data-f="new" onclick="setFiltro('new',this)">New</button>
        <button class="fchip" data-f="co" onclick="setFiltro('co',this)">Carry Over</button>
      </div>
      <div class="grid"><div class="lc-card" data-modelo="Kwid MY" data-f="total">
  <div class="lc-car-photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Kwid MY" class="lc-car-img" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="lc-card-hd">
    <div>
      <div class="lc-model">Kwid MY</div>
      <div class="lc-sub">SOS 09/2026 · 0 meses · <span class="ph ph-care">CARE</span></div>
    </div>

<script>
'use strict';
var curModel = 'all';


function setFiltro(f, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.fchip').forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('active'); });
  el.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('#ws-legacy .lc-card').forEach(function(c) {
    c.classList.toggle('show', c.dataset.f === f);
  });
}



function irWorkspace(w) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ws').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav:not(.dim)').forEach(function (n) { n.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.getElementById('ws-' + w).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('nav-' + w).classList.add('active');
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

/* Abertura por frequência — troca no lugar, sem mudar a altura do card */
function toggleFreq(el) {
  var s = el.closest('.slide');
  var k = s.querySelector('.lc-kpis'), f = s.querySelector('.lc-freq');
  if (!k || !f) return;
  var abrir = f.style.display === 'none';
  f.style.display = abrir ? 'block' : 'none';
  k.style.display = abrir ? 'none' : 'grid';
}

/* ── Compartilhar o card como imagem ──────────────────────────────────
   No modo "app" (standalone) o iOS só permite compartilhar dentro da janela
   de ativação do toque. Por isso a biblioteca é pré-carregada e, se o
   compartilhamento nativo for recusado, a imagem abre num visualizador
   onde o usuário salva segurando o dedo (link de download não funciona
   em app instalado no iPhone). */
var _h2c = null;
function carregarH2C() {
  if (_h2c) return _h2c;
  _h2c = new Promise(function (ok, falha) {
    if (window.html2canvas) return ok(window.html2canvas);
    var s = document.createElement('script');
    s.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js';
    s.onload = function () { ok(window.html2canvas); };
    s.onerror = function () { _h2c = null; falha(new Error('CDN indisponível')); };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (!window.html2canvas) { _h2c = null; falha(new Error('tempo esgotado')); }
    }, 10000);
  });
  return _h2c;
}
/* Pré-carrega sem atrasar a abertura da página */
if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
  requestIdleCallback(function () { carregarH2C().catch(function () {}); });
} else {
  setTimeout(function () { carregarH2C().catch(function () {}); }, 2500);
}

function resumoTexto(card) {
  var t = [card.querySelector('.lc-model').textContent.trim()];
  var b = card.querySelector('.lc-badge');
  if (b) t.push('Saúde: ' + b.textContent.trim());
  var s1 = card.querySelector('.slide');
  if (s1) {
    s1.querySelectorAll('.lc-kpi').forEach(function (k) {
      var l = k.querySelector('.lc-kpi-l'), v = k.querySelector('.lc-kpi-v');
      if (l && v) t.push(l.textContent.replace('A·B·C·C2·PD', '').trim()
                       + ': ' + v.textContent.trim());
    });
  }
  card.querySelectorAll('.lc-cnt').forEach(function (c) {
    t.push(c.querySelector('.lc-cnt-l').textContent.trim() + ': '
         + c.querySelector('.lc-cnt-v').textContent.trim());
  });
  return t.join('\n');
}

function abrirVisor(url, nome, texto) {
  var ov = document.getElementById('shareOv');
  ov.querySelector('#shareImg').src = url;
  var lnk = ov.querySelector('#shareDl');
  lnk.href = url; lnk.download = nome + '.png';
  ov.querySelector('#shareTxt').onclick = function () {
    if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(texto);
    this.textContent = 'Resumo copiado ✓';
  };
  ov.classList.add('on');
}
function fecharVisor() {
  var ov = document.getElementById('shareOv');
  ov.classList.remove('on');
  ov.querySelector('#shareTxt').textContent = 'Copiar resumo em texto';
}

function compartilhar(btn) {
  var card = btn.closest('.lc-card');
  var nome = (card.dataset.modelo || 'card').replace(/[^\w\s()-]/g, '').trim();
  var texto = resumoTexto(card);
  btn.classList.add('busy');
  var fim = function () { btn.classList.remove('busy'); };

  carregarH2C().then(function (h2c) {
    return h2c(card, { backgroundColor: '#ffffff', scale: 2, logging: false, useCORS: true });
  }).then(function (cv) {
    return new Promise(function (ok) { cv.toBlob(ok, 'image/png'); });
  }).then(function (blob) {
    var arq = new File([blob], nome + '.png', { type: 'image/png' });
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [arq] })) {
      return navigator.share({ files: [arq], title: nome }).catch(function (e) {
        if (e && e.name === 'AbortError') return;   // usuário cancelou
        abrirVisor(url, nome, texto);               // recusado no modo app
      });
    }
    abrirVisor(url, nome, texto);
  }).catch(function () {
    if (navigator.share) {
      return navigator.share({ title: nome, text: texto }).catch(function () {});
    }
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      return navigator.clipboard.writeText(texto).then(function () {
        alert('Imagem indisponível nesta rede — resumo copiado.');
      });
    }
    alert(texto);
  }).then(fim, fim);
}

/* Carrossel */
function goSlide(btn, i) {
  var card = btn.closest('.lc-card');
  var sl = card.querySelector('.slides');
  sl.scrollTo({ left: sl.clientWidth * i, behavior: 'smooth' });
}
function syncDots(sl) {
  var i = Math.round(sl.scrollLeft / Math.max(1, sl.clientWidth));
  var dots = sl.closest('.lc-card').querySelectorAll('.dot-b');
  dots.forEach(function(d, j){ d.classList.toggle('on', j === i); });
}

setFiltro('total', document.querySelector('.fchip[data-f="total"]'));
</script>
